title: AY: database day runbook with backup and stop rules
public_pr_body:
Adds numbered operator commands for consistent encrypted backup/dump, protected empty-target restore and full fingerprint/file comparisons, preflight, 138 then 144-146, per-phase verification and separately approved reverse rollback. Each step has a stop rule. Explicitly holds absent 140-143 and separate chase atomic release. Retains destructive rollback and 146 no-reinstall cautions.
